gui.eminus.settings.title: Eminus Settings
gui.eminus.settings.ingestion.hint: Convert the chunks you see into far-terrain cells. With it off, nothing new reaches the store.
The finest detail kept on disk. One voxel covers 1 block at Full, 2 at High, 4 at Medium, 8 at Low and 16 at Minimal. Full keeps single blocks — a flower, a torch — at the far layer's nearest edge; High drops them and cuts the store to about a seventh.
gui.eminus.settings.far_render_cells.hin: How far the far layer reaches. Work grows with the square of this distance: more meshes walked each frame, and more of them in video memory.
gui.eminus.settings.worker_threads.hint: Background threads that build LOD. Higher catches up faster and competes harder with the game's own chunk builders; lower is the other way round.
gui.eminus.settings.detail_distance.hint: How far out the finer detail of LOD reaches. Each step up doubles that distance and costs more video memory. A higher screen resolution reaches further at the same step.
gui.eminus.settings.detail_distance.limi: Not reached right now: the geometry arena is full, so LOD is drawn coarser than this setting asks.
gui.eminus.settings.fog.hint: Fog over LOD, carried on from the game's own fog and full at the far render distance. Off also clears the open-air fog from the loaded chunks, so the whole view stays clear. Fog in the Nether, from a boss, under water or from blindness stays.
gui.eminus.settings.fade.hint: Fade LOD out over its last 512 blocks instead of ending it in a hard line.
